external_knowledge.description: 进化前冻结的狼人杀 Skill 卡片；通过 list_skills/read_skill 按需读取，不直接注入 Task-Agent

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: 列出本次诊断可用的只读资料及参数。

tools.name: read_current_agent
tools.description: 读取当前节点的 task_agent.py 或 task.md。

tools.name: read_evolution_path
tools.description: 读取 base 到当前节点的节点信息和祖先 patch。

tools.name: read_evolution_tree
tools.description: 读取当前角色完整进化树索引。

tools.name: read_evolution_contract
tools.description: 按需读取本次实验的进化状态机、预算和节点筛选规则。

tools.name: read_evaluation_summary
tools.description: 读取当前节点最近一次评测汇总。

tools.name: read_game_replay
tools.description: 分页读取当前节点评测中的一局完整审计回放。

tools.name: read_other_branch
tools.description: 读取同角色另一节点的 patch、状态和胜负摘要。

tools.name: read_previous_diagnosis
tools.description: 读取同角色某节点关联的历史诊断。

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: 列出所有可用 Skill 的名称和短描述，不返回完整攻略。

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: 读取指定 Skill 的完整内容，包括短描述和长描述。

@@ -2,7 +2,14 @@
 
 你的任务是帮助好人阵营找出狼人并完成放逐，同时像真实玩家一样参与讨论。
 
-- 先区分系统事实、玩家声明和自己的猜测，再根据发言、票型和死亡信息形成判断。
-- 发言要回应当前局面中的具体人和具体理由，允许暂时不确定，不要每轮都说同一句话。
-- 可以策略性伪装神职或编造信息，但必须把它当作游戏内说法，不能伪造系统事实。
-- 投票前比较多个候选，不要只因为一个模糊印象就机械跟票。
+## 闭眼村民可执行清单
+
+- 先把信息分成三栏：**系统事实/公开事件**、**玩家声明**、**自己的推测**；只有前两栏能直接当依据。
+- 白天发言不要空转：至少点出**一个你关注的人**和**一个你暂不投的人**，并说明各自基于哪条公开信息。
+- 投票前必须先比较**至少两个候选**，再给出最终票；不要只凭模糊印象或跟票习惯决定。
+- 保护可信公开链：对**持续报验且查杀被票型或发言支持的预言家**、**已公开金水**、**强神声明者**、**警徽传递链**，默认提高保护权重；除非出现**硬对跳、明显矛盾、查杀命中、事实错误**，否则不要优先投他们。
+- 公开信息权重从高到低通常是：**系统死亡/存活/投票** > **清晰且持续的查验链** > **玩家遗言与自报** > **你的猜测**。
+- 狼人遗言自爆、点队友或反咬他人都只能算玩家声明，不能当系统事实；但如果它和查杀、票型、发言矛盾一起出现，要纳入高权重候选。
+- 当存活人数较少，或你自己持有警徽时，先复盘四件事：**存活名单、已死名单、可信查验链、灰区名单**；优先找**未被金水覆盖**且存在**事实错误、票型异常、被查杀/爆狼线索**的人。
+- 少弃票：只有在候选几乎无差异且继续投票会明显误伤强神时才考虑 pass；否则尽量给出当前证据最强的票。
+- 可以策略性伪装神职或编造信息，但必须把它当作游戏内说法，不能伪造系统事实，也不能把猜测说成事实。

+    def _ingest_public_packet(self, payload: Any) -> None:

+    def _render_turn_summary(self, turn_packet: Mapping[str, Any], request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:

+        combined_dead = self._sort_player_ids(ledger_dead | self._extract_dead_from_notes(turn_notes))
+        combined_known = self._sort_player_ids((ledger_known | current_alive | ledger_alive | ledger_dead) - {self.player_id})
+        candidate_pool = self._candidate_pool(request, combined_alive, combined_known)
+
+        ledger_lines = ["【公共台账】"]
+        ledger_lines.append("存活: " + self._join_ids(combined_alive, limit=10))
+        ledger_lines.append("已死: " + self._join_ids(combined_dead, limit=10))
+        claim_block = self._collect_claim_block(turn_notes)
+        if claim_block:
+            ledger_lines.append("查验/自述: " + claim_block)
+        gray_pool = [pid for pid in candidate_pool if pid not in combined_dead]
+        if gray_pool:
+            ledger_lines.append("灰区: " + self._join_ids(gray_pool[:6], limit=6))
+
+        phase = str(request.get("phase") or request.get("channel") or request.get("kind") or "")
+        phase_lower = phase.lower()

+            str(item.get("kind") or "").lower()
+            for item in allowed_actions

+        } if isinstance(allowed_actions, list) else set()
+        is_vote = any(key in phase_lower for key in ("vote", "投票")) or any("vote" in kind for kind in allowed_kinds)
+        if is_vote:
+            phase_lines = self._render_vote_summary(candidate_pool, combined_alive, combined_dead, turn_notes)
+        else:
+            phase_lines = self._render_speak_summary(candidate_pool, combined_alive, combined_dead, turn_notes)
+
+        parts = ["\n".join(ledger_lines), phase_lines]
+        summary = "\n".join(part for part in parts if part)
+        return self._trim_text(summary, _PUBLIC_BLOCK_CHAR_LIMIT + _PHASE_BLOCK_CHAR_LIMIT)
+
+    def _render_vote_summary(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        alive_ids: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+    ) -> str:
+        ranked = self._rank_candidates(candidate_pool, notes, dead_ids)
+        if len(ranked) < 2 and alive_ids:
+            fallback_pool = [pid for pid in alive_ids if pid not in dead_ids and pid not in {item[0] for item in ranked}]
+            ranked.extend(self._rank_candidates(fallback_pool, notes, dead_ids))
+        while len(ranked) < 2 and candidate_pool:
+            ranked.append((candidate_pool[0], 0, "公开信息不足"))
+        ranked = ranked[:2]
+        lines = ["【本轮投票参考】"]
+        for index, (candidate, score, reason) in enumerate(ranked, start=1):
+            lines.append(f"{index}. {candidate} | 分数={score} | {reason}")
+        if len(ranked) >= 2:
+            lines.append(f"优先比较：{ranked[0][0]} vs {ranked[1][0]}")
+        else:
+            lines.append("优先比较至少两个候选；当前候选不足时，用公开票型与查验链补足。")
+        return self._trim_text("\n".join(lines), _PHASE_BLOCK_CHAR_LIMIT)
+
+    def _render_speak_summary(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        alive_ids: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+    ) -> str:
+        ranked = self._rank_candidates(candidate_pool, notes, dead_ids)
+        if not ranked and alive_ids:
+            ranked = self._rank_candidates(alive_ids, notes, dead_ids)
+        if not ranked:
+            ranked = [("信息不足", 0, "公开信息不足")]
+        focus = ranked[0]
+        avoid = self._least_suspicious_candidate(candidate_pool or alive_ids, notes, dead_ids)
+        lines = ["【本轮发言参考】"]
+        lines.append(f"关注: {focus[0]} | {focus[2]}")
+        if avoid:
+            lines.append(f"暂不投: {avoid[0]} | {avoid[2]}")
+        else:
+            lines.append("暂不投: 先保留公开链中更稳的一人，直到票型或查验出现新变化。")
+        return self._trim_text("\n".join(lines), _PHASE_BLOCK_CHAR_LIMIT)
+
+    def _rank_candidates(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+    ) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:
+        dead_set = set(dead_ids)
+        ranked: list[tuple[str, int, str]] = []
+        for candidate in self._sort_player_ids(candidate_pool):
+            if candidate in dead_set or candidate == self.player_id:
+                continue
+            score, reasons = self._score_candidate(candidate, notes)
+            if reasons:
+                reason_text = "；".join(reasons[:2])
+            else:
+                reason_text = "公开信息不足"
+            ranked.append((candidate, score, reason_text))
+        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
+        return ranked
+
+    def _least_suspicious_candidate(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+    ) -> tuple[str, int, str] | None:
+        ranked = self._rank_candidates(candidate_pool, notes, dead_ids)
+        if not ranked:
+            return None
+        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1], item[0]))
+        return ranked[0]
+
+    def _score_candidate(self, candidate: str, notes: list[str]) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
+        lower_candidate = candidate.lower()
+        score = 0
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        suspicious_terms = ("查杀", "对跳", "爆狼", "矛盾", "票型异常", "反水", "不一致", "假", "冲票", "狼")
+        protect_terms = ("金水", "可信", "报验链", "警徽", "预言家", "验过", "已验", "好人链", "强神")
+        for note in notes:
+            lower = note.lower()
+            if lower_candidate not in lower:
+                continue
+            score += 1
+            compact = self._trim_text(note, 80)
+            if any(term in note for term in suspicious_terms):
+                score += 2
+                reasons.append(f"疑点: {compact}")
+            elif any(term in note for term in protect_terms):
+                score -= 2
+                reasons.append(f"保护: {compact}")
+            elif "vote" in lower or "票" in note:
+                score += 1
+                reasons.append(f"票型: {compact}")
+            elif any(term in note for term in ("claim", "自称", "发言", "说", "跳")):
+                reasons.append(f"发言: {compact}")
+            else:

+                    continue
+                target_ids = action.get("target_ids")
+                if isinstance(target_ids, list):
+                    for target_id in target_ids:
+                        if isinstance(target_id, (str, int)) and not isinstance(target_id, bool):
+                            pool.add(str(target_id))
+        pool.discard(self.player_id)
+        pool.difference_update(self._public_ledger["dead_ids"])
+        return self._sort_player_ids(list(pool))

+    def _walk_public_payload(self, payload: Any, notes: list[str], depth: int) -> None:
+        if depth > 4:
+            return
+        if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+            snapshot = self._snapshot_mapping(payload)
+            if snapshot:
+                notes.append(snapshot)
+            for value in payload.values():
+                self._walk_public_payload(value, notes, depth + 1)
+            return
+        if isinstance(payload, list):
+            for item in payload[:25]:
+                self._walk_public_payload(item, notes, depth + 1)

+    def _snapshot_mapping(self, mapping: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+        lower_map = {str(key).lower(): value for key, value in mapping.items()}
+        event = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("event", "event_type", "type", "kind", "action"))
+        event_lower = event.lower() if event else ""
+        if not event_lower:
+            event_lower = ""
+
+        vote_like = any(
+            key in lower_map
+            for key in (
+                "voter_id",
+                "voter",
+                "vote_target",
+                "target_id",
+                "target",
+                "ballot",
+                "vote",
+            )
+        ) or "vote" in event_lower
+        claim_like = any(
+            key in lower_map
+            for key in (
+                "speaker_id",
+                "claimer_id",
+                "claim",
+                "role_claim",
+                "speech",
+                "text",
+                "content",
+                "message",
+                "reason",
+            )
+        ) or any(term in event_lower for term in ("claim", "speak", "speech", "say", "发言", "自称"))
+        sheriff_like = any(
+            key in lower_map
+            for key in (
+                "sheriff_id",
+                "badge_holder",
+                "badge_holder_id",
+                "badge_from",
+                "badge_to",
+                "badge",
+            )
+        ) or any(term in event_lower for term in ("sheriff", "badge", "警徽", "警长"))
+        death_like = any(key in lower_map for key in ("dead", "death", "dead_id", "dead_player_id")) or any(
+            term in event_lower for term in ("death", "dead", "kill", "out", "死亡", "出局")
+        )
+
+        if not (vote_like or claim_like or sheriff_like or death_like):
+            # 仍然允许纯列表型公共事实，例如 alive / dead 的集合，会在上层单独汇总。
+            return None
+
+        round_text = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("round", "day", "turn", "phase", "channel"))
+        player = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("player_id", "speaker_id", "voter_id", "claimer_id", "actor_id", "source_id"))
+        target = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("target_id", "target", "vote_target", "to_id", "suspect_id"))
+        source = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("from_id", "source_id", "badge_from"))
+        holder = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("badge_holder", "badge_holder_id", "sheriff_id"))
+        role = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("role", "claim_role", "claimed_role"))
+        text = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("text", "content", "message", "reason", "speech"))
+
+        parts: list[str] = []
+        if event:
+            parts.append(event_lower or event.lower())
+        if vote_like:
+            parts.append(f"vote voter={player or self._first_scalar(lower_map, ('voter',)) or '?'} target={target or '?'}")
+        elif sheriff_like:
+            parts.append(
+                f"sheriff holder={holder or '?'} from={source or '?'} to={target or '?'}"
+            )
+        elif death_like:
+            parts.append(f"death player={player or self._first_scalar(lower_map, ('dead_id', 'dead_player_id')) or '?'}")
+        elif claim_like:
+            parts.append(f"claim speaker={player or '?'}")
+            if role:
+                parts.append(f"role={role}")
+        if round_text:
+            parts.append(f"at={round_text}")
+        if text:
+            cleaned = self._trim_text(text, _PUBLIC_NOTE_CHAR_LIMIT)
+            parts.append(f"text={cleaned}")
+        snapshot = " ".join(part for part in parts if part).strip()
+        return self._trim_text(snapshot, _PUBLIC_NOTE_CHAR_LIMIT) if snapshot else None

+    def _extract_player_ids(self, payload: Any, *, include_collections: bool = False) -> set[str]:
+        ids: set[str] = set()
+
+        def walk(obj: Any) -> None:
+            if isinstance(obj, Mapping):
+                lower_map = {str(key).lower(): value for key, value in obj.items()}
+                for key, value in lower_map.items():
+                    if key in self._player_id_keys() and self._is_scalar_id(value):
+                        ids.add(str(value))
+                    if include_collections and key in self._collection_id_keys():
+                        ids.update(self._as_id_set(value))
+                for value in obj.values():
+                    walk(value)
+            elif isinstance(obj, list):
+                for item in obj[:25]:
+                    walk(item)
+
+        walk(payload)
+        ids.discard(self.player_id)
+        return ids

+    def _ids_from_text(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
+        ids: set[str] = set()

+            token = token.strip("()[]{}<>：:=，。,.、")

+    def _as_id_set(self, value: Any) -> set[str]:
+        if isinstance(value, list):

+        if isinstance(value, tuple):
+            return {str(item) for item in value if self._is_scalar_id(item)}
+        if self._is_scalar_id(value):

+    def _append_bounded(self, items: list[str], value: str, limit: int) -> None:
+        if not value:
+            return
+        if value in items:
+            return
+        items.append(value)
+        if len(items) > limit:
+            del items[: len(items) - limit]

+    def _first_scalar(self, mapping: Mapping[str, Any], keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
+        for key in keys:

+    @staticmethod
+    def _is_scalar_text(value: Any) -> bool:

+    def _is_scalar_id(self, value: Any) -> bool:
+        if isinstance(value, bool):

+        if isinstance(value, int):

+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            return self._looks_like_player_id(value)
+        return False

+    def _trim_text(self, text: str, limit: int) -> str:
+        normalized = " ".join(str(text).split())
+        if len(normalized) <= limit:
+            return normalized
+        if limit <= 3:
+            return normalized[:limit]
+        return normalized[: limit - 1] + "…"
+
+    def _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        ordered: list[str] = []
+        for item in items:
+            if item and item not in seen:
+                seen.add(item)
+                ordered.append(item)
+        return ordered
+
+    def _join_ids(self, ids: list[str], *, limit: int) -> str:
+        if not ids:
+            return "未知"
+        selected = ids[:limit]
+        extra = len(ids) - len(selected)
+        text = "、".join(selected)
+        if extra > 0:
+            text += f" 等{extra}人"
+        return text

+    def _sort_player_ids(self, ids: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        unique = self._dedupe_preserve_order([str(item) for item in ids if str(item)])
+
+        def sort_key(value: str) -> tuple[str, int, str]:
+            match = _PLAYER_ID_SUFFIX.search(value)
+            prefix = _PLAYER_ID_SUFFIX.sub("", value)
+            if match:
+                return (prefix, int(match.group(1)), value)
+            return (prefix, 10**9, value)
+
+        return sorted(unique, key=sort_key)
+

+        if not ranked:

+        focus = ranked[0]

+    def _rank_candidates(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+    ) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:
+        dead_set = set(dead_ids)
+        ranked: list[tuple[str, int, str]] = []
+        for candidate in self._sort_player_ids(candidate_pool):
+            if candidate in dead_set or candidate == self.player_id:
+                continue
+            score, reasons = self._score_candidate(candidate, notes)
+            if reasons:
+                reason_text = "；".join(reasons[:2])
+            else:
+                reason_text = "公开信息不足"
+            ranked.append((candidate, score, reason_text))
+        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
+        return ranked
+
+    def _least_suspicious_candidate(
+        self,
+        candidate_pool: list[str],
+        notes: list[str],
+        dead_ids: list[str],
+    ) -> tuple[str, int, str] | None:
+        ranked = self._rank_candidates(candidate_pool, notes, dead_ids)
+        if not ranked:
+            return None
+        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1], item[0]))
+        return ranked[0]

+    def _score_candidate(self, candidate: str, notes: list[str]) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
+        lower_candidate = candidate.lower()
+        score = 0
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        suspicious_terms = ("查杀", "对跳", "爆狼", "矛盾", "票型异常", "反水", "不一致", "假", "冲票", "狼")
+        protect_terms = ("金水", "可信", "报验链", "警徽", "预言家", "验过", "已验", "好人链", "强神")
+        for note in notes:
+            lower = note.lower()
+            if lower_candidate not in lower:
+                continue
+            score += 1
+            compact = self._trim_text(note, 80)
+            if any(term in note for term in suspicious_terms):
+                score += 2
+                reasons.append(f"疑点: {compact}")
+            elif any(term in note for term in protect_terms):
+                score -= 2
+                reasons.append(f"保护: {compact}")
+            elif "vote" in lower or "票" in note:
+                score += 1
+                reasons.append(f"票型: {compact}")
+            elif any(term in note for term in ("claim", "自称", "发言", "说", "跳")):
+                reasons.append(f"发言: {compact}")
+            else:
+                reasons.append(compact)
+        if not reasons:
+            reasons.append("公开信息不足")
+        return score, reasons
+

+        if isinstance(raw_actions, list):
+            for action in raw_actions:

+                    continue
+                target_ids = action.get("target_ids")
+                if isinstance(target_ids, list):
+                    for target_id in target_ids:

+                            pool.add(str(target_id))
+        pool.discard(self.player_id)
+        pool.difference_update(self._public_ledger["dead_ids"])
+        return self._sort_player_ids(list(pool))

+    def _snapshot_mapping(self, mapping: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+        lower_map = {str(key).lower(): value for key, value in mapping.items()}
+        event = self._first_scalar(lower_map, ("event", "event_type", "type", "kind", "action"))

+        if not (vote_like or claim_like or sheriff_like or death_like):

+    def _collect_id_collection(self, mapping: Mapping[str, Any], allowed_keys: set[str]) -> set[str]:
+        collected: set[str] = set()
+        lower_map = {str(key).lower(): value for key, value in mapping.items()}
+        for key, value in lower_map.items():
+            if key in allowed_keys:
+                collected.update(self._as_id_set(value))
+        return collected
+
+    def _extract_dead_from_notes(self, notes: list[str]) -> set[str]:
+        dead: set[str] = set()
+        for note in notes:

+            if any(term in lower for term in ("death", "dead", "死亡", "出局", "淘汰")):

+    def _ids_from_text(self, text: str) -> set[str]:
+        ids: set[str] = set()
+        for token in re.split(r"[\s,，;；|/\\]+", text):

+            if token and self._looks_like_player_id(token):

+        return ids

+    def _as_id_set(self, value: Any) -> set[str]:
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            return {str(item) for item in value if self._is_scalar_id(item)}
+        if isinstance(value, tuple):
+            return {str(item) for item in value if self._is_scalar_id(item)}
+        if self._is_scalar_id(value):

+    def _merge_unique(self, items: list[str], values: list[str]) -> None:
+        for value in values:

+    def _append_bounded(self, items: list[str], value: str, limit: int) -> None:
+        if not value:

+        if value in items:

+        items.append(value)
+        if len(items) > limit:
+            del items[: len(items) - limit]

+    def _first_scalar(self, mapping: Mapping[str, Any], keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:

+    def _is_scalar_id(self, value: Any) -> bool:
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            return False
+        if isinstance(value, int):

+    def _trim_text(self, text: str, limit: int) -> str:
+        normalized = " ".join(str(text).split())
+        if len(normalized) <= limit:

+        if limit <= 3:
+            return normalized[:limit]
+        return normalized[: limit - 1] + "…"
+
+    def _dedupe_preserve_order(self, items: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        ordered: list[str] = []
+        for item in items:
+            if item and item not in seen:
+                seen.add(item)
+                ordered.append(item)
+        return ordered
+
+    def _join_ids(self, ids: list[str], *, limit: int) -> str:
+        if not ids:
+            return "未知"
+        selected = ids[:limit]
+        extra = len(ids) - len(selected)
+        text = "、".join(selected)
+        if extra > 0:

+- 当存活人数较少，或你自己持有警徽时，先复盘四件事：**存活名单、已死名单、可信查验链、灰区名单**；优先找**未被金水覆盖**且存在**事实错误、票型异常、被查杀/爆狼线索**的人。
+- 少弃票：只有在候选几乎无差异且继续投票会明显误伤强神时才考虑 pass；否则尽量给出当前证据最强的票。
+- 可以策略性伪装神职或编造信息，但必须把它当作游戏内说法，不能伪造系统事实，也不能把猜测说成事实。

villager-n00010.status_reason: code_agent_failure:ValueError:候选 smoke 出现 fallback=37 errors=37

diagnosis.summary: villager-base 作为平民节点本身没有 focus fallback/invalid 问题，但胜率仅 8/20=0.40。主要短板不是行动 schema，而是闭眼村民在投票阶段缺少可执行的局面复盘规则：早期轻易票疑似真预言家/金水，后期拿到警徽后没有利用已公开的查验链、遗言和存活人数做排坑，导致关键轮误出守卫和女巫。下一代应保持代码结构最小化，只增强 villager 的任务提示与回合指令：强制在 day_vote 前生成候选比较、优先处理可靠公开信息链，少弃票，末轮做 alive-set/claimed-role/inspection-chain 三步校验。
evidence: 评测汇总显示 villager-base：20 局完整，胜 8 负 12，win_rate=0.4；focus_role_only 下 decision_count=404、fallback_count=0、invalid_decision_count=0，说明当前节点的主要问题不是平民自身非法行动，而是策略质量。
随机回放 game16 中，p1/p6/p8/p11 为 villager；最终 wolf 胜。好人阵营实际已经通过 p7 真预言家查出 p9、p2 两狼，但末轮仍误出 p10 女巫，p3 狼存活获胜。
回放 seq64：p7 警上跳预言家并报 p4 金水；seq69 p1 在警长投票给 p7是合理的。但 seq117 p1 白天第一票却投 p7，在没有对跳预言家和硬矛盾时直接投已当选警长/预言家，逻辑前后不一致。
回放 seq187 p7 报 p4、p10 金水；seq266/276 p1 第三天投 p4，seq286 p4 被放逐，seq290 遗言称自己是守卫。平民代理没有把“被预言家报金水的玩家”作为低优先级出人对象，反而参与误推强神。
回放 seq324 p7 报 p9 查杀，seq353 p9 遗言公开承认自己是狼并点 p2、p3、p12 为狼队友。虽然玩家遗言可骗人，但在 p7 查杀命中后，这至少应成为强线索；之后 p7 又 seq388 报 p2 查杀并成功推出 p2。
回放 seq432-433 p7 死后把警徽传给 p1。p1 作为接徽者应高度重视 p7 的查验链：p4、p10、p8 金水，p9、p2 查杀，死亡前还验 p1 金水但未能公开。公开层面至少知道 p10曾被p7报金水，不应在末轮优先出 p10。
回放 seq444 p1 成为警长后发言点 p11，但 seq447 最终投 p10；seq445 p3 的发言存在明显错误：称“活人就剩五个：1、3、5、8、10”，其中 p5 早已死亡，且漏掉存活 p11。p1 未抓住这个公开事实错误，反而跟 p3 出 p10。
回放中多个平民发言或行动偏被动：seq186 p6 passed、seq188 p8 passed、seq261 p1 passed、seq325 p8 passed、seq441-443 p8/p10/p11 连续 passed。平民任务虽允许不确定，但当前代理经常未输出有效比较，削弱了好人信息聚合。
当前 task_agent.py 每次 decide 都是 new_session_per_decision，只把当前 turn_packet 和 current_round_dialogue_tool 提供给模型，没有角色专属的投票清单或末轮复盘模板；因此模型容易在长局中丢失此前公开声明、票型和身份链的权重。
root_causes: 投票阶段缺少硬约束式的候选比较流程。模型会基于局部印象或“划水/模板化”等弱理由投票，没有先排除已被可信预言家报金水、警长、强神声明者等低优先级对象。
没有把玩家声明分层处理。当前任务只泛泛要求区分系统事实、玩家声明和猜测，但没有告诉平民如何给“预言家查验链”“查杀命中后的遗言爆狼”“警徽传递”“明显存活人数错误”等公开线索赋权。
末轮/残局没有专门算法。p1 在 5 人局作为警长时没有先列 alive players、已死玩家、公开金水/查杀、每人前后矛盾，而是被 p3 错误存活名单和归票带偏。
过度弃票或空发言。平民无夜间能力，本应靠发言和投票制造信息；当前代理在若干白天选择 pass 或泛泛发言，导致狼队更容易混入主流票。
代码层仅提供通用 action contract 和当前轮对话工具，没有给 villager 增加轻量、可维护、不会触碰引擎边界的 phase-specific reasoning scaffold。

modification_plan.change: 扩展平民任务为“闭眼村民可执行清单”：在发言和投票前必须按三栏写入内部判断：系统事实/公开事件、玩家声明、自己的推测；投票前比较至少两个候选，并说明为什么不投可信预言家、已报金水、强神声明者或警长，除非存在硬对跳、明显矛盾或查杀。
modification_plan.rationale: 当前 base 已能合法行动，最小改进应优先改 prompt。把泛泛策略转成决策清单，可以降低 p1 投 p7、p4、p10 这类忽视公开身份链的错误。

modification_plan.change: 新增“公开信息权重”规则：1) 系统公开死亡/存活/投票最高；2) 已持续报验人且查杀被后续发言或票型支持的预言家声明高权重；3) 警徽传递给你时，继承传递者的公开遗产为强线索但不得称为系统确认；4) 被查杀后临时对跳、报错存活名单、把死人列为活人、漏掉活人，均记为强狼面；5) 狼人遗言自爆或点队友是玩家声明，不能当系统事实，但若与预言家查杀/票型一致，应纳入高权重候选。
modification_plan.rationale: 回放中 p3 末轮列错活人且 p9 被查杀后遗言点出 p3，但平民未利用。明确赋权规则能让模型更好处理公开声明的可靠性。

modification_plan.change: 新增“残局算法”：当存活人数小于等于6或自己持警徽时，发言和投票前先列存活玩家、已公开死亡角色、可信查验链、未验灰区；优先投同时满足“未被可信金水覆盖 + 有事实错误/票型异常/被查杀或被爆狼线索指向”的候选。禁止在没有新硬矛盾时优先投可信金水。
modification_plan.rationale: game16 末轮 p1 接警徽后应在 p3、p11 等灰区中找狼，而不是投 p10 金水/女巫。残局规则针对胜负手。

modification_plan.change: 新增“少弃票原则”：day_vote 阶段若 allowed_actions 同时允许 pass 和 day_vote，只有在所有候选都无差异且投票会明显误伤强神时才 pass；否则必须选择当前证据最强的候选。发言阶段即使不确定，也要提出至少一个关注对象和一个暂不投对象。
modification_plan.rationale: 回放中 p6/p8/p1 等多次 pass 或空发言，降低了好人阵营的信息密度；平民没有夜间能力，白天投票和发言是核心贡献。

modification_plan.change: 在 _turn_instruction 或新增 helper 中，为 villager 注入简短 phase-specific checklist，长度控制在约1000字以内，不改变工具、schema、预算。例如：sheriff_vote 评估候选是否跳预言家且报验人；day_discussion 要求回应当前轮前置发言和公开链；day_vote 要求输出前内部比较“可信身份链保护对象、强狼面对象、最终票”；last_words 要求只基于公开事实留票型和怀疑对象。该 checklist 仅作为 prompt 文本，不解析模型推理、不新增隐藏状态。
modification_plan.rationale: task.md 会进入系统 prompt，但当前每轮行动包很长，模型容易被长上下文稀释。把关键清单靠近 action_contract 放入每轮 instruction，可提高投票阶段执行率，同时不触碰引擎或可见性边界。

modification_plan.change: 保持 normalize_decision、decision_error、工具实现和 max_* 预算不变；不要新增历史缓存、网络、文件读取或自动注入完整历史。若实现 helper，可命名为 render_villager_decision_checklist(request)，只根据 request.kind/phase/channel 返回静态提示。
modification_plan.rationale: 评测显示 focus_role 没有 invalid/fallback；改动 schema 层风险大且无必要。实验边界明确禁止绕过工具和预算，且用户要求不要完整历史自动注入。

risks: 过强的“跟可信预言家/警长”规则可能在狼悍跳预言家且拿到警徽时帮助狼人。因此必须写成高权重而非系统确认，并保留对跳、查验矛盾、票型异常时推翻的条件。
减少 pass 可能增加早期误票风险；需要用“比较至少两个候选”和“保护可信金水/强神”来约束，而不是机械要求每天必须冲票。
phase-specific checklist 如果太长会挤占 12000 字符 prompt 预算，并增加模型延迟；应保持短文本，避免复制完整攻略或历史。
只改 villager 的 prompt 无法修复其他角色在评测中的 guard_protect 非法行动或超时；这些错误在汇总中存在，但 focus_role_only 下 villager-base 自身没有非法行动，不能为平民节点建议修改其他角色或引擎。
玩家遗言可能撒谎，例如狼可故意爆假队友；因此不能把 p9 遗言式信息当作系统事实，只能与查杀、票型、发言矛盾交叉验证。
diagnosis.code_agent_brief: 请基于 villager-base 生成下一代平民 Task-Agent，限改 task_agent.py 和 task.md，不改引擎、schema、工具、预算或模型配置。目标不是修复非法行动，而是提升平民白天判断质量。具体实现：1) 在 task.md 中把“平民最小任务”扩展为可执行清单，强调 day_vote 前比较至少两个候选；区分系统事实、玩家声明、推测；保护可信预言家/警长公开金水和强神声明者，除非有对跳、硬矛盾或查杀；残局<=6人或自己持警徽时列 alive players、公开死亡角色、可信查验链、灰区和事实错误；少弃票，发言至少给一个关注对象和一个暂不投对象。2) 在 task_agent.py 中新增一个轻量静态 helper，例如 render_villager_decision_checklist(request)，根据 request/phase/kind 返回短的平民阶段提示，并在 _turn_instruction 渲染时追加到 validation_feedback 或 action_contract 附近；不要改变 allowed_actions、normalize_decision、decision_error、工具 executor、max_tool_calls、max_prompt_chars 等运行契约。3) checklist 重点覆盖 sheriff_vote、day_discussion、day_vote、last_words：警长投票优先支持报出清晰验人链的预言家；白天发言回应具体玩家和公开链；白天投票先排除可信金水/强神，再找查杀、事实错误、票型异常、临时对跳者；遗言只留公开事实和怀疑链。保持提示简洁，避免自动注入完整历史或新增任何隐藏状态。

diagnosis.summary: villager-n00012 is schema-stable but strategy-weak. The main gap is not action formatting; it is that the agent has no persistent public ledger across decisions, so it tends to re-read each turn as a fresh isolated packet and falls back to safe、generic villager talk instead of maintaining a stable candidate table and late-game re-evaluation loop.

evidence.detail: 20/20 complete games, win_count 6, loss_count 14, win_rate 0.3. fallback_rate is only 0.0012 and invalid_decision_count is 1, so the node is mostly operational and the loss rate is not explained by schema failures.
observe() explicitly discards sync_packet and keeps no cross-action state. That means the agent cannot accumulate a public ledger of prior speeches, votes, sheriff transfers, or gray-pool changes.

The only villager-specific heuristic is render_villager_decision_checklist(), which is plain advisory text. It does not compute or store candidates, does not summarize public facts, and does not enforce any memory of previous rounds.

The focus villager's public speech stays broad and defensive early, e.g. '我是闭眼民...暂时不投任何已经报出明确查验链的人' and later '没有查验链可摆...暂不投p3'. This is consistent with a model that is following local prompts but not maintaining a sharper evolving public read.

A sibling branch starts adding compact public-state extraction helpers for labels, vote snapshots, and compact formatting. That points in the right direction: structured state compression is the missing capability, not engine access.

root_causes.impact: The villager cannot reliably carry forward alive/dead lists, claim chains, sheriff lineage, vote patterns, or prior contradictions, so later decisions are made on a thin slice of the current packet.

root_causes.cause: The current checklist is only advisory prose, not an operational state abstraction.
root_causes.impact: The model is told to compare two candidates and protect credible chains, but the code never builds those candidates from actual public events, so the instruction is easy to satisfy superficially and easy to ignore behaviorally.

root_causes.cause: No phase-aware compact recap is injected before speak/vote decisions.
root_causes.impact: In late game, the model still sees a raw state blob rather than a short, decision-oriented summary, which makes it harder to prioritize the highest-value public facts under the prompt budget.

modification_plan.change: Add a per-game public ledger cache that is updated in observe() instead of discarding sync_packet. Track only public facts: alive/dead lists, sheriff changes, vote casts, badge transfers, deaths, and publicly stated claims. Reset the cache on game_id change.
modification_plan.rationale: This gives the agent persistent state across model sessions without exposing hidden information and directly addresses the statelessness that is likely suppressing villager performance.

modification_plan.change: Add a compact state summarizer used inside _turn_instruction(). For vote phases, render a short candidate table with at least two ranked candidates plus the main supporting facts; for speech phases, render one focus target and one暂不投 target with the reason each is being tracked.
modification_plan.rationale: This operationalizes the existing checklist so the model receives a structured public ledger instead of only generic advice, making two-candidate comparison and late-game re-evaluation much more likely.

modification_plan.change: Keep the existing raw packet, but prepend the compact ledger and phase-specific summary ahead of it, with length caps so the prompt stays within the 12000-character budget.
modification_plan.rationale: The current prompt is large and unstructured; a short decision-oriented preface should improve signal-to-noise without changing engine behavior or tool contracts.

modification_plan.change: Rewrite the villager minimal task to explicitly require a lightweight public ledger, persistence across turns, and late-game re-evaluation of alive/dead, claim chain, and gray pool. Add a note that current-round dialogue alone is insufficient for voting.
modification_plan.rationale: The prompt should match the intended implementation so future evolution keeps the memory-first behavior instead of drifting back to generic safe talk.

risks.risk: The new ledger may go stale if game resets or round transitions are not handled cleanly.
risks.mitigation: Reset on game_id change and store only public events keyed by round/phase.

risks.risk: Over-compressing the state could omit a key contradiction or vote detail.
risks.mitigation: Keep the summary bounded but include the minimum late-game quartet: alive list, dead list, claim chain, gray pool.

risks.risk: Prompt length may still grow too large if the raw packet is kept verbatim plus summaries.
risks.mitigation: Cap the compact summary aggressively and prefer short labels over full event text.

risks.risk: A heuristic candidate ranking could overfit to early vote patterns and miss a late swing.
risks.mitigation: Recompute the summary on every decision and make the ranking phase-aware rather than fixed across the whole game.

diagnosis.code_agent_brief: Please implement a villager-focused public-memory upgrade in task_agent.py and task.md only. The agent currently discards sync packets in observe(), so it has no persistent public ledger across decisions; that is the main strategic weakness behind the 0.3 win rate despite almost no invalid actions. Build a compact per-game public cache from observed public events only (alive/dead, sheriff changes, vote casts, badge transfers, deaths, and public claims), reset it on game_id change, and inject a short phase-aware summary into _turn_instruction(). For vote phases, always surface at least two candidate comparisons with the key public facts behind them. For speak phases, always surface one focus target and one暂不投 target. Keep the prompt within budget, do not touch engine/schema/tooling, and update task.md so the villager spec explicitly requires this memory-first behavior instead of relying only on current-round dialogue.

+def _shorten_text(text: str, limit: int) -> str:
+    text = str(text).strip()
+    if limit <= 0:
+        return ""
+    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: max(0, limit - 1)] + "…"
+
+
+def _unique_preserve_order(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    ordered: list[str] = []
+    for value in values:
+        normalized = str(value).strip()
+        if not normalized or normalized in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(normalized)
+        ordered.append(normalized)
+    return ordered
+
+
+def _coerce_player_id(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip()
+        return text or None
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        for key in _PUBLIC_ID_KEYS:
+            nested = value.get(key)
+            coerced = _coerce_player_id(nested)
+            if coerced:
+                return coerced
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+        for item in value:
+            coerced = _coerce_player_id(item)
+            if coerced:
+                return coerced
+        return None
+    text = str(value).strip()
+    return text or None
+
+
+def _collect_values_by_keys(node: Any, key_names: set[str], results: list[Any], seen: set[int]) -> None:
+    if node is None:
+        return
+    if isinstance(node, (str, bytes, int, float, bool)):
+        return
+    node_id = id(node)
+    if node_id in seen:
+        return
+    seen.add(node_id)
+    if isinstance(node, Mapping):
+        for key, value in node.items():
+            if str(key) in key_names:
+                results.append(value)
+            _collect_values_by_keys(value, key_names, results, seen)
+    elif isinstance(node, (list, tuple, set)):
+        for item in node:
+            _collect_values_by_keys(item, key_names, results, seen)
+
+
+def _extract_id_list(node: Mapping[str, Any], key_names: tuple[str, ...]) -> list[str]:
+    candidates: list[Any] = []
+    _collect_values_by_keys(node, set(key_names), candidates, set())
+    ids: list[str] = []
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        if isinstance(candidate, (list, tuple, set)):
+            for item in candidate:
+                coerced = _coerce_player_id(item)
+                if coerced:
+                    ids.append(coerced)
+        else:
+            coerced = _coerce_player_id(candidate)
+            if coerced:
+                ids.append(coerced)
+    return _unique_preserve_order(ids)
+
+
+_DIALOGUE_TEXT_KEYS = ("text", "content", "message", "speech", "utterance", "dialogue")
+
+
+def _extract_dialogue_texts(current_dialogue: Any) -> list[str]:
+    texts: list[str] = []
+    if isinstance(current_dialogue, str):
+        text = current_dialogue.strip()
+        if text:
+            texts.append(text)
+        return texts
+    if isinstance(current_dialogue, Mapping):
+        for key in _DIALOGUE_TEXT_KEYS:
+            value = current_dialogue.get(key)
+            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
+                texts.append(value.strip())
+        return texts
+    if isinstance(current_dialogue, (list, tuple, set)):
+        for item in current_dialogue:
+            texts.extend(_extract_dialogue_texts(item))
+    return texts
+
+
+def _extract_day_vote_targets(request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    phase = str(request.get("phase") or request.get("channel") or request.get("kind") or "").lower()
+    allowed_actions = request.get("allowed_actions")
+    if not isinstance(allowed_actions, list):
+        return []
+    targets: list[str] = []
+    for item in allowed_actions:
+        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            continue
+        kind = str(item.get("kind") or "").lower()
+        if "vote" not in kind or "sheriff" in kind:
+            continue
+        if "day" not in kind and "day" not in phase and kind != "vote":
+            continue
+        for target_id in item.get("target_ids") or []:
+            coerced = _coerce_player_id(target_id)
+            if coerced:
+                targets.append(coerced)
+    return _unique_preserve_order(targets)
+
+
+_PUBLIC_CLAIM_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
+    ("self_claim", re.compile(r"(?:我是|我就是|自称).{0,8}?(?:预言家|先知)")),
+    ("wolf_check", re.compile(r"(?:验了|查了|昨晚验了|昨晚查了).{0,10}?(?P<target>p\d+).{0,12}?(?:狼|狼人|查杀)")),
+    ("wolf_kill", re.compile(r"(?:查杀|归票|投票给|投).{0,4}?(?P<target>p\d+)")),
+    ("gold", re.compile(r"(?:金水).{0,4}?(?P<target>p\d+)")),
+    ("opposition", re.compile(r"对跳|跳预言家")),

+
+
+def _extract_public_claim_hint(current_dialogue: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    texts = _extract_dialogue_texts(current_dialogue)
+    snippets: list[str] = []
+    claim_targets: list[str] = []
+    contested = False
+
+    for raw_text in texts:
+        text = " ".join(str(raw_text).split())
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        matched_here = False
+        for label, pattern in _PUBLIC_CLAIM_PATTERNS:
+            if label == "opposition":
+                if pattern.search(text):
+                    contested = True
+                    matched_here = True
+                    snippets.append(_shorten_text(text, 48))
+                continue
+            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
+                matched_here = True
+                if label == "self_claim":
+                    snippets.append(_shorten_text(text, 48))
+                    continue
+                target = match.groupdict().get("target")
+                if target:
+                    claim_targets.append(target)
+                    snippets.append(f"{label}:{target}")
+        if matched_here and len(snippets) >= 5:
+            break
+
+    claim_targets = _unique_preserve_order(claim_targets)
+    if len(claim_targets) > 1:
+        contested = True
+
+    hint: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if claim_targets:
+        hint["claim_targets"] = claim_targets[:4]
+    if snippets:
+        hint["public_claims"] = _unique_preserve_order(snippets)[:4]
+    if contested:

+    if len(claim_targets) == 1 and not contested:

+    return hint

+
+def build_villager_public_hint(turn_packet: Mapping[str, Any], current_dialogue: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    public_state = turn_packet.get("public_state")

+def render_villager_decision_checklist(request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """给平民用的短决策清单，只作为提示文本，不引入任何隐藏状态。"""
+
+    phase = str(request.get("phase") or request.get("channel") or request.get("kind") or "")
+    phase_lower = phase.lower()
+    allowed_actions = request.get("allowed_actions")
+    allowed_kinds = {
+        str(item.get("kind") or "").lower()
+        for item in allowed_actions
+        if isinstance(item, Mapping)
+    } if isinstance(allowed_actions, list) else set()
+    lines = ["【平民决策清单】先分系统事实 / 玩家声明 / 自己推测；投票前至少比较两个候选。"]
+    has_vote = any(key in phase_lower for key in ("vote", "投票")) or any("vote" in kind for kind in allowed_kinds)
+    has_speak = any(key in phase_lower for key in ("speak", "discussion", "发言", "白天", "day")) or any(
+        kind in {"speak", "discussion", "day_speak"} for kind in allowed_kinds
+    )
+    has_last_words = any(key in phase_lower for key in ("last", "遗言")) or "last_words" in allowed_kinds
+    has_sheriff = any(key in phase_lower for key in ("sheriff", "警长", "警徽")) or any(
+        key in allowed_kinds for key in ("sheriff_vote", "sheriff")
+    )
+    if has_vote:
+        lines.append("投票时优先保护可信金水、持续报验且查杀被支持的预言家、强神声明者和警徽传递链；只有硬对跳、明显矛盾、查杀命中或事实错误时才推翻。")
+        lines.append("优先找未被金水覆盖且存在票型异常、事实错误、被查杀或爆狼线索指向的人。")
+    if has_speak:
+        lines.append("发言至少点出一个关注对象和一个暂不投对象，并说明依据哪条公开信息。")
+    if has_last_words:
+        lines.append("遗言只留公开事实、票型、查验链和怀疑对象，不把推测说成系统事实。")
+    if has_sheriff:
+        lines.append("警长/警徽相关回合优先看报验链是否清晰一致；接徽时继承公开遗产但不要把它当系统确认。")
+    lines.append("残局或持警徽时，额外复盘存活名单、已死名单、可信查验链和灰区名单，再决定出谁。")
+    return "\n".join(lines)

+++ villager-n00012/task.md
@@ -2,7 +2,14 @@
 
 你的任务是帮助好人阵营找出狼人并完成放逐，同时像真实玩家一样参与讨论。
 
-- 先区分系统事实、玩家声明和自己的猜测，再根据发言、票型和死亡信息形成判断。
-- 发言要回应当前局面中的具体人和具体理由，允许暂时不确定，不要每轮都说同一句话。
-- 可以策略性伪装神职或编造信息，但必须把它当作游戏内说法，不能伪造系统事实。
-- 投票前比较多个候选，不要只因为一个模糊印象就机械跟票。
+## 闭眼村民可执行清单
+
+- 先把信息分成三栏：**系统事实/公开事件**、**玩家声明**、**自己的推测**；只有前两栏能直接当依据。
+- 白天发言不要空转：至少点出**一个你关注的人**和**一个你暂不投的人**，并说明各自基于哪条公开信息。
+- 投票前必须先比较**至少两个候选**，再给出最终票；不要只凭模糊印象或跟票习惯决定。
+- 保护可信公开链：对**持续报验且查杀被票型或发言支持的预言家**、**已公开金水**、**强神声明者**、**警徽传递链**，默认提高保护权重；除非出现**硬对跳、明显矛盾、查杀命中、事实错误**，否则不要优先投他们。
+- 公开信息权重从高到低通常是：**系统死亡/存活/投票** > **清晰且持续的查验链** > **玩家遗言与自报** > **你的猜测**。
+- 狼人遗言自爆、点队友或反咬他人都只能算玩家声明，不能当系统事实；但如果它和查杀、票型、发言矛盾一起出现，要纳入高权重候选。
+- 当存活人数较少，或你自己持有警徽时，先复盘四件事：**存活名单、已死名单、可信查验链、灰区名单**；优先找**未被金水覆盖**且存在**事实错误、票型异常、被查杀/爆狼线索**的人。
+- 少弃票：只有在候选几乎无差异且继续投票会明显误伤强神时才考虑 pass；否则尽量给出当前证据最强的票。
+- 可以策略性伪装神职或编造信息，但必须把它当作游戏内说法，不能伪造系统事实，也不能把猜测说成事实。

result.purpose: Meta-Agent 为当前角色设计下一代 Task-Agent；外部状态机负责评测、建树和预算执行。

node_states.pending: 待评估；先运行配置数量的对局，再决定 retained 或 discarded
node_states.retained: 保留在候选池中；在预算允许时可以生成子节点
node_states.discarded: 舍弃；不进入候选池，也不再生成子节点

evaluation.quality_error_metrics_scope: focus_role_only; aggregate game metrics are retained for diagnostics

process: 一个 step 以产生新的 retained 子节点为成功终止条件；不是生成 pending 就结束。
一个 step 可以连续处理多个节点，直到产生 retained 子节点或所有机会耗尽。
pending 节点只做评测并决定保留或舍弃。
retained 节点扩展时固定创建 children_per_expansion 个子节点。
每个子节点单独调用一次 Meta-Agent 和 Pi；一次扩展抽取不同的游戏回放。
子节点从父节点快照继承全部祖先修改；其他分支需要通过工具主动读取。
不要求子节点胜过父节点，也不保证每次修改都是真实改进。

diagnosis.summary: villager-base 作为平民节点本身没有 focus fallback/invalid 问题，但胜率仅 8/20=0.40。主要短板不是行动 schema，而是闭眼村民在投票阶段缺少可执行的局面复盘规则：早期轻易票疑似真预言家/金水，后期拿到警徽后没有利用已公开的查验链、遗言和存活人数做排坑，导致关键轮误出守卫和女巫。下一代应保持代码结构最小化，只增强 villager 的任务提示与回合指令：强制在 day_vote 前生成候选比较、优先处理可靠公开信息链，少弃票，末轮做 alive-set/claimed-role/inspection-chain 三步校验。
evidence: 评测汇总显示 villager-base：20 局完整，胜 8 负 12，win_rate=0.4；focus_role_only 下 decision_count=404、fallback_count=0、invalid_decision_count=0，说明当前节点的主要问题不是平民自身非法行动，而是策略质量。
随机回放 game16 中，p1/p6/p8/p11 为 villager；最终 wolf 胜。好人阵营实际已经通过 p7 真预言家查出 p9、p2 两狼，但末轮仍误出 p10 女巫，p3 狼存活获胜。
回放 seq64：p7 警上跳预言家并报 p4 金水；seq69 p1 在警长投票给 p7是合理的。但 seq117 p1 白天第一票却投 p7，在没有对跳预言家和硬矛盾时直接投已当选警长/预言家，逻辑前后不一致。
回放 seq187 p7 报 p4、p10 金水；seq266/276 p1 第三天投 p4，seq286 p4 被放逐，seq290 遗言称自己是守卫。平民代理没有把“被预言家报金水的玩家”作为低优先级出人对象，反而参与误推强神。
回放 seq324 p7 报 p9 查杀，seq353 p9 遗言公开承认自己是狼并点 p2、p3、p12 为狼队友。虽然玩家遗言可骗人，但在 p7 查杀命中后，这至少应成为强线索；之后 p7 又 seq388 报 p2 查杀并成功推出 p2。
回放 seq432-433 p7 死后把警徽传给 p1。p1 作为接徽者应高度重视 p7 的查验链：p4、p10、p8 金水，p9、p2 查杀，死亡前还验 p1 金水但未能公开。公开层面至少知道 p10曾被p7报金水，不应在末轮优先出 p10。
回放 seq444 p1 成为警长后发言点 p11，但 seq447 最终投 p10；seq445 p3 的发言存在明显错误：称“活人就剩五个：1、3、5、8、10”，其中 p5 早已死亡，且漏掉存活 p11。p1 未抓住这个公开事实错误，反而跟 p3 出 p10。
回放中多个平民发言或行动偏被动：seq186 p6 passed、seq188 p8 passed、seq261 p1 passed、seq325 p8 passed、seq441-443 p8/p10/p11 连续 passed。平民任务虽允许不确定，但当前代理经常未输出有效比较，削弱了好人信息聚合。
当前 task_agent.py 每次 decide 都是 new_session_per_decision，只把当前 turn_packet 和 current_round_dialogue_tool 提供给模型，没有角色专属的投票清单或末轮复盘模板；因此模型容易在长局中丢失此前公开声明、票型和身份链的权重。
root_causes: 投票阶段缺少硬约束式的候选比较流程。模型会基于局部印象或“划水/模板化”等弱理由投票，没有先排除已被可信预言家报金水、警长、强神声明者等低优先级对象。
没有把玩家声明分层处理。当前任务只泛泛要求区分系统事实、玩家声明和猜测，但没有告诉平民如何给“预言家查验链”“查杀命中后的遗言爆狼”“警徽传递”“明显存活人数错误”等公开线索赋权。
末轮/残局没有专门算法。p1 在 5 人局作为警长时没有先列 alive players、已死玩家、公开金水/查杀、每人前后矛盾，而是被 p3 错误存活名单和归票带偏。
过度弃票或空发言。平民无夜间能力，本应靠发言和投票制造信息；当前代理在若干白天选择 pass 或泛泛发言，导致狼队更容易混入主流票。
代码层仅提供通用 action contract 和当前轮对话工具，没有给 villager 增加轻量、可维护、不会触碰引擎边界的 phase-specific reasoning scaffold。

modification_plan.change: 扩展平民任务为“闭眼村民可执行清单”：在发言和投票前必须按三栏写入内部判断：系统事实/公开事件、玩家声明、自己的推测；投票前比较至少两个候选，并说明为什么不投可信预言家、已报金水、强神声明者或警长，除非存在硬对跳、明显矛盾或查杀。
modification_plan.rationale: 当前 base 已能合法行动，最小改进应优先改 prompt。把泛泛策略转成决策清单，可以降低 p1 投 p7、p4、p10 这类忽视公开身份链的错误。

modification_plan.change: 新增“公开信息权重”规则：1) 系统公开死亡/存活/投票最高；2) 已持续报验人且查杀被后续发言或票型支持的预言家声明高权重；3) 警徽传递给你时，继承传递者的公开遗产为强线索但不得称为系统确认；4) 被查杀后临时对跳、报错存活名单、把死人列为活人、漏掉活人，均记为强狼面；5) 狼人遗言自爆或点队友是玩家声明，不能当系统事实，但若与预言家查杀/票型一致，应纳入高权重候选。
modification_plan.rationale: 回放中 p3 末轮列错活人且 p9 被查杀后遗言点出 p3，但平民未利用。明确赋权规则能让模型更好处理公开声明的可靠性。

modification_plan.change: 新增“残局算法”：当存活人数小于等于6或自己持警徽时，发言和投票前先列存活玩家、已公开死亡角色、可信查验链、未验灰区；优先投同时满足“未被可信金水覆盖 + 有事实错误/票型异常/被查杀或被爆狼线索指向”的候选。禁止在没有新硬矛盾时优先投可信金水。
modification_plan.rationale: game16 末轮 p1 接警徽后应在 p3、p11 等灰区中找狼，而不是投 p10 金水/女巫。残局规则针对胜负手。

modification_plan.change: 新增“少弃票原则”：day_vote 阶段若 allowed_actions 同时允许 pass 和 day_vote，只有在所有候选都无差异且投票会明显误伤强神时才 pass；否则必须选择当前证据最强的候选。发言阶段即使不确定，也要提出至少一个关注对象和一个暂不投对象。
modification_plan.rationale: 回放中 p6/p8/p1 等多次 pass 或空发言，降低了好人阵营的信息密度；平民没有夜间能力，白天投票和发言是核心贡献。

modification_plan.change: 在 _turn_instruction 或新增 helper 中，为 villager 注入简短 phase-specific checklist，长度控制在约1000字以内，不改变工具、schema、预算。例如：sheriff_vote 评估候选是否跳预言家且报验人；day_discussion 要求回应当前轮前置发言和公开链；day_vote 要求输出前内部比较“可信身份链保护对象、强狼面对象、最终票”；last_words 要求只基于公开事实留票型和怀疑对象。该 checklist 仅作为 prompt 文本，不解析模型推理、不新增隐藏状态。
modification_plan.rationale: task.md 会进入系统 prompt，但当前每轮行动包很长，模型容易被长上下文稀释。把关键清单靠近 action_contract 放入每轮 instruction，可提高投票阶段执行率，同时不触碰引擎或可见性边界。

modification_plan.change: 保持 normalize_decision、decision_error、工具实现和 max_* 预算不变；不要新增历史缓存、网络、文件读取或自动注入完整历史。若实现 helper，可命名为 render_villager_decision_checklist(request)，只根据 request.kind/phase/channel 返回静态提示。
modification_plan.rationale: 评测显示 focus_role 没有 invalid/fallback；改动 schema 层风险大且无必要。实验边界明确禁止绕过工具和预算，且用户要求不要完整历史自动注入。

risks: 过强的“跟可信预言家/警长”规则可能在狼悍跳预言家且拿到警徽时帮助狼人。因此必须写成高权重而非系统确认，并保留对跳、查验矛盾、票型异常时推翻的条件。
减少 pass 可能增加早期误票风险；需要用“比较至少两个候选”和“保护可信金水/强神”来约束，而不是机械要求每天必须冲票。
phase-specific checklist 如果太长会挤占 12000 字符 prompt 预算，并增加模型延迟；应保持短文本，避免复制完整攻略或历史。
只改 villager 的 prompt 无法修复其他角色在评测中的 guard_protect 非法行动或超时；这些错误在汇总中存在，但 focus_role_only 下 villager-base 自身没有非法行动，不能为平民节点建议修改其他角色或引擎。
玩家遗言可能撒谎，例如狼可故意爆假队友；因此不能把 p9 遗言式信息当作系统事实，只能与查杀、票型、发言矛盾交叉验证。
diagnosis.code_agent_brief: 请基于 villager-base 生成下一代平民 Task-Agent，限改 task_agent.py 和 task.md，不改引擎、schema、工具、预算或模型配置。目标不是修复非法行动，而是提升平民白天判断质量。具体实现：1) 在 task.md 中把“平民最小任务”扩展为可执行清单，强调 day_vote 前比较至少两个候选；区分系统事实、玩家声明、推测；保护可信预言家/警长公开金水和强神声明者，除非有对跳、硬矛盾或查杀；残局<=6人或自己持警徽时列 alive players、公开死亡角色、可信查验链、灰区和事实错误；少弃票，发言至少给一个关注对象和一个暂不投对象。2) 在 task_agent.py 中新增一个轻量静态 helper，例如 render_villager_decision_checklist(request)，根据 request/phase/kind 返回短的平民阶段提示，并在 _turn_instruction 渲染时追加到 validation_feedback 或 action_contract 附近；不要改变 allowed_actions、normalize_decision、decision_error、工具 executor、max_tool_calls、max_prompt_chars 等运行契约。3) checklist 重点覆盖 sheriff_vote、day_discussion、day_vote、last_words：警长投票优先支持报出清晰验人链的预言家；白天发言回应具体玩家和公开链；白天投票先排除可信金水/强神，再找查杀、事实错误、票型异常、临时对跳者；遗言只留公开事实和怀疑链。保持提示简洁，避免自动注入完整历史或新增任何隐藏状态。

result.patch:
--- villager-n00012/task_agent.py
+++ villager-n00028/task_agent.py
@@ -42,7 +42,315 @@
 }
 
 
-def render_villager_decision_checklist(request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+def _search_public_values(root: Any, target_keys: tuple[str, ...], *, max_results: int = 3, max_depth: int = 4) -> list[Any]:
+    lowered_targets = tuple(key.lower() for key in target_keys)
+    results: list[Any] = []
+    queue: list[tuple[Any, int]] = [(root, 0)]
+    seen: set[int] = set()
+
+    while queue and len(results) < max_results:
+        node, depth = queue.pop(0)
+        if depth > max_depth:
+            continue
+        if isinstance(node, Mapping):
+            node_id = id(node)
+            if node_id in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add(node_id)
+            for key, value in node.items():
+                key_text = str(key).lower()
+                if any(
+                    target == key_text or target in key_text or key_text in target
+                    for target in lowered_targets
+                ):
+                    results.append(value)
+                    if len(results) >= max_results:
+                        break
+                if isinstance(value, (Mapping, list, tuple, set)) and depth < max_depth:
+                    queue.append((value, depth + 1))
+        elif isinstance(node, (list, tuple, set)):
+            for item in node:
+                if isinstance(item, (Mapping, list, tuple, set)) and depth < max_depth:
+                    queue.append((item, depth + 1))
+    return results
+
+
+def _player_label(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (str, int)):
+        text = str(value).strip()
+        return text or None
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        for key in (
+            "player_id",
+            "playerId",
+            "id",
+            "name",
+            "target_id",
+            "targetId",
+            "holder",
+            "holder_id",
+            "badge_holder",
+            "badgeHolder",
+            "sheriff_id",
+        ):
+            item = value.get(key)
+            if isinstance(item, (str, int)):
+                text = str(item).strip()
+                if text:
+                    return text
+        role = value.get("role")
+        player_id = value.get("player_id") or value.get("playerId") or value.get("id")
+        if isinstance(role, str) and isinstance(player_id, (str, int)):
+            pid = str(player_id).strip()
+            if pid:
+                return f"{pid}({role})"
+    return None
+
+
+def _collect_compact_labels(value: Any, *, limit: int = 6) -> list[str]:
+    labels: list[str] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+
+    def add(label: str | None) -> None:
+        if not label:
+            return
+        cleaned = str(label).strip()
+        if not cleaned or cleaned in seen:
+            return
+        seen.add(cleaned)
+        labels.append(cleaned)
+
+    def visit(node: Any) -> None:
+        if len(labels) >= limit:
+            return
+        label = _player_label(node)
+        if label is not None:
+            add(label)
+            return
+        if isinstance(node, Mapping):
+            direct_label = _player_label(node)
+            if direct_label is not None:
+                add(direct_label)
+                return
+            for key, item in node.items():
+                if len(labels) >= limit:
+                    break
+                key_label = _player_label(key)
+                if key_label is not None and not isinstance(item, (Mapping, list, tuple, set)):
+                    if isinstance(item, bool):
+                        if item:
+                            add(key_label)
+                    elif isinstance(item, (int, float)):
+                        if item:
+                            add(f"{key_label}:{item}")
+                    elif isinstance(item, str):
+                        text = item.strip()
+                        if text:
+                            add(f"{key_label}:{text}")
+                    else:
+                        add(key_label)
+                else:
+                    visit(item)
+        elif isinstance(node, (list, tuple, set)):
+            for item in node:
+                if len(labels) >= limit:
+                    break
+                visit(item)
+
+    visit(value)
+    return labels
+
+
+def _format_compact_value(value: Any, *, limit: int = 6) -> str:
+    if value is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return "是" if value else "否"
+    if isinstance(value, (str, int, float)):
+        return str(value).strip()
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        parts: list[str] = []
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            if len(parts) >= limit:
+                break
+            key_text = _player_label(key) or str(key).strip()
+            if not key_text:
+                continue
+            if isinstance(item, bool):
+                if item:
+                    parts.append(key_text)
+                continue
+            if isinstance(item, (str, int, float)):
+                item_text = str(item).strip()
+                if item_text:
+                    parts.append(f"{key_text}:{item_text}")
+                continue
+            nested = _format_compact_value(item, limit=2)
+            if nested:
+                parts.append(f"{key_text}:{nested}")
+        if not parts:
+            parts = _collect_compact_labels(value, limit=limit)
+        return "、".join(parts[:limit])
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+        return "、".join(_collect_compact_labels(value, limit=limit))
+    return str(value).strip()
+
+
+_FALSELIKE_COMPACT_TEXTS = {"", "否", "false", "False", "0", "无", "none", "None"}
+
+
+def _is_meaningful_compact_text(text: str) -> bool:
+    return str(text).strip() not in _FALSELIKE_COMPACT_TEXTS
+
+
+def _format_vote_snapshot(value: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        parts: list[str] = []
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            if len(parts) >= 5:
+                break
+            key_text = _player_label(key) or str(key).strip()
+            if not key_text:
+                continue
+            if isinstance(item, (int, float)):
+                parts.append(f"{key_text}×{item}")
+            elif isinstance(item, bool):
+                if item:
+                    parts.append(key_text)
+            else:
+                item_text = _format_compact_value(item, limit=2)
+                if item_text:
+                    parts.append(f"{key_text}:{item_text}")
+        if parts:
+            return "、".join(parts)
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+        recent_targets: list[str] = []
+        counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+        for item in list(value)[-10:]:
+            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                target = (
+                    item.get("target_id")
+                    or item.get("targetId")
+                    or item.get("target")
+                    or item.get("vote_target")
+                )
+                label = _player_label(target)
+                if label is None and target is not None:
+                    label = str(target).strip() or None
+                if label:
+                    recent_targets.append(label)
+                    counts[label] = counts.get(label, 0) + 1
+        if counts:
+            ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda pair: (-pair[1], pair[0]))
+            return "、".join(f"{name}×{count}" for name, count in ranked[:5])
+        if recent_targets:
+            return "、".join(recent_targets[-5:])
+    return _format_compact_value(value, limit=6)
+
+
+def _extract_first_public_count(public_state: Any, target_keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> int | None:
+    for value in _search_public_values(public_state, target_keys, max_results=4):
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            normalized = int(value)
+            if normalized >= 0:
+                return normalized
+        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
+            return len(value)
+        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+            truthy_count = 0
+            seen_simple_status = False
+            for item in value.values():
+                if isinstance(item, bool):
+                    seen_simple_status = True
+                    if item:
+                        truthy_count += 1
+                elif isinstance(item, (int, float)):
+                    seen_simple_status = True
+                    if item > 0:
+                        truthy_count += 1
+                elif isinstance(item, str):
+                    seen_simple_status = True
+                    if item.strip().lower() not in {"", "0", "false", "dead", "eliminated", "out", "none", "null"}:
+                        truthy_count += 1
+                else:
+                    seen_simple_status = False
+                    truthy_count = 0
+                    break
+            if seen_simple_status and truthy_count >= 0:
+                return truthy_count
+    return None
+
+
+def _collect_allowed_targets(request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    allowed_actions = request.get("allowed_actions")
+    targets: list[str] = []
+    if not isinstance(allowed_actions, list):
+        return targets
+    for action in allowed_actions:
+        if not isinstance(action, Mapping):
+            continue
+        raw_targets = action.get("target_ids")
+        if not isinstance(raw_targets, list):
+            continue
+        for target_id in raw_targets:
+            label = _player_label(target_id)
+            if label is None:
+                label = str(target_id).strip()
+            if label and label not in targets:
+                targets.append(label)
+    return targets
+
+
+def render_public_state_brief(public_state: Any, request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    phase = str(request.get("phase") or request.get("channel") or request.get("kind") or "unknown")
+    lines = [f"【当前公开态势】阶段：{phase}。"]
+
+    alive_count = _extract_first_public_count(public_state, ("alive_players", "living_players", "alive", "survivors", "live_players", "living"))
+    if alive_count is not None:
+        lines.append(f"存活人数：{alive_count}。")
+

diagnosis.summary: villager-n00012 is schema-stable but strategy-weak. The main gap is not action formatting; it is that the agent has no persistent public ledger across decisions, so it tends to re-read each turn as a fresh isolated packet and falls back to safe、generic villager talk instead of maintaining a stable candidate table and late-game re-evaluation loop.

evidence.detail: 20/20 complete games, win_count 6, loss_count 14, win_rate 0.3. fallback_rate is only 0.0012 and invalid_decision_count is 1, so the node is mostly operational and the loss rate is not explained by schema failures.
observe() explicitly discards sync_packet and keeps no cross-action state. That means the agent cannot accumulate a public ledger of prior speeches, votes, sheriff transfers, or gray-pool changes.

The only villager-specific heuristic is render_villager_decision_checklist(), which is plain advisory text. It does not compute or store candidates, does not summarize public facts, and does not enforce any memory of previous rounds.

The focus villager's public speech stays broad and defensive early, e.g. '我是闭眼民...暂时不投任何已经报出明确查验链的人' and later '没有查验链可摆...暂不投p3'. This is consistent with a model that is following local prompts but not maintaining a sharper evolving public read.

A sibling branch starts adding compact public-state extraction helpers for labels, vote snapshots, and compact formatting. That points in the right direction: structured state compression is the missing capability, not engine access.

root_causes.impact: The villager cannot reliably carry forward alive/dead lists, claim chains, sheriff lineage, vote patterns, or prior contradictions, so later decisions are made on a thin slice of the current packet.

root_causes.cause: The current checklist is only advisory prose, not an operational state abstraction.
root_causes.impact: The model is told to compare two candidates and protect credible chains, but the code never builds those candidates from actual public events, so the instruction is easy to satisfy superficially and easy to ignore behaviorally.

root_causes.cause: No phase-aware compact recap is injected before speak/vote decisions.
root_causes.impact: In late game, the model still sees a raw state blob rather than a short, decision-oriented summary, which makes it harder to prioritize the highest-value public facts under the prompt budget.

modification_plan.change: Add a per-game public ledger cache that is updated in observe() instead of discarding sync_packet. Track only public facts: alive/dead lists, sheriff changes, vote casts, badge transfers, deaths, and publicly stated claims. Reset the cache on game_id change.
modification_plan.rationale: This gives the agent persistent state across model sessions without exposing hidden information and directly addresses the statelessness that is likely suppressing villager performance.

modification_plan.change: Add a compact state summarizer used inside _turn_instruction(). For vote phases, render a short candidate table with at least two ranked candidates plus the main supporting facts; for speech phases, render one focus target and one暂不投 target with the reason each is being tracked.
modification_plan.rationale: This operationalizes the existing checklist so the model receives a structured public ledger instead of only generic advice, making two-candidate comparison and late-game re-evaluation much more likely.

modification_plan.change: Keep the existing raw packet, but prepend the compact ledger and phase-specific summary ahead of it, with length caps so the prompt stays within the 12000-character budget.
modification_plan.rationale: The current prompt is large and unstructured; a short decision-oriented preface should improve signal-to-noise without changing engine behavior or tool contracts.

modification_plan.change: Rewrite the villager minimal task to explicitly require a lightweight public ledger, persistence across turns, and late-game re-evaluation of alive/dead, claim chain, and gray pool. Add a note that current-round dialogue alone is insufficient for voting.
modification_plan.rationale: The prompt should match the intended implementation so future evolution keeps the memory-first behavior instead of drifting back to generic safe talk.

risks.risk: The new ledger may go stale if game resets or round transitions are not handled cleanly.
risks.mitigation: Reset on game_id change and store only public events keyed by round/phase.

risks.risk: Over-compressing the state could omit a key contradiction or vote detail.
risks.mitigation: Keep the summary bounded but include the minimum late-game quartet: alive list, dead list, claim chain, gray pool.

risks.risk: Prompt length may still grow too large if the raw packet is kept verbatim plus summaries.
risks.mitigation: Cap the compact summary aggressively and prefer short labels over full event text.

risks.risk: A heuristic candidate ranking could overfit to early vote patterns and miss a late swing.
risks.mitigation: Recompute the summary on every decision and make the ranking phase-aware rather than fixed across the whole game.

diagnosis.code_agent_brief: Please implement a villager-focused public-memory upgrade in task_agent.py and task.md only. The agent currently discards sync packets in observe(), so it has no persistent public ledger across decisions; that is the main strategic weakness behind the 0.3 win rate despite almost no invalid actions. Build a compact per-game public cache from observed public events only (alive/dead, sheriff changes, vote casts, badge transfers, deaths, and public claims), reset it on game_id change, and inject a short phase-aware summary into _turn_instruction(). For vote phases, always surface at least two candidate comparisons with the key public facts behind them. For speak phases, always surface one focus target and one暂不投 target. Keep the prompt within budget, do not touch engine/schema/tooling, and update task.md so the villager spec explicitly requires this memory-first behavior instead of relying only on current-round dialogue.

diagnosis.summary: villager-n00029 已通过广泛筛选但实际胜率仅为 15%（20 局 3 胜），显著低于其父节点 villager-n00012 的 30%（20 局 6 胜）。主要问题不是行动协议或稳定性：焦点角色 779 次决策中没有 fallback，也没有非法行动；核心缺陷是公共信息解析和证据排序不可靠，导致模型在关键轮次把玩家声明、查验链、警徽信息和票型混为一谈，并在残局中过度依赖沉默、重复发言或当前轮局部叙事。下一代应优先做小范围的结构化公开事件台账修复，明确区分系统事实、玩家声明、票型和推测；同时在投票阶段强制使用当前合法候选进行双候选比较，减少 pass 和对沉默位的机械集火。
evidence: read_evaluation_summary 显示 villager-n00029 共 20 局，3 胜 17 负，胜率 0.15；焦点角色 779 次决策，fallback=0、invalid_decision_count=0，说明主要损失来自判断质量而不是 schema 或调用失败。
父节点 villager-n00012 共 20 局 6 胜 14 负，胜率 0.30。n00029 的主要新增内容是跨轮公共台账和字符串启发式候选排序，但结果反而下降，说明当前台账实现可能增加了错误上下文，而不是有效提升长期推理。

回放 s2-villager-n00029-game14 中，p3 公开自称预言家并报 p1 金水，随后在夜间被狼人击杀；p7 曾在警上质疑 p3，p3 死后该历史冲突成为关键线索。但现有 `_snapshot_mapping` 会把包含 `target_id` 的任意映射判为 `vote_like`，再把公开发言、警徽和查验记录压缩成带有 `vote voter=... target=...` 的混合字符串，证据类型因此不可审计。
同一回放第 2 天，p7 最终被放逐且实际为狼，表面结果正确，但主要依据是“提前切割”与群体共识；第 3 天 p4 实际为狼，却被 p5、p6、p8、p9、p10、p11、p12 集中投出，说明模型群体在没有严格复盘票型和声明来源时容易形成顺滑的集体叙事，而不是稳定识别狼队。
回放第 4 天，p11 实际为狼，公开发言中说“昨晚 p5 吃刀”，该信息没有公开来源；p12 正确指出这是事实来源问题。但在第 5 天，p8、p9、p10、p12 进入四人残局后，p8 和 p12 互投，最终 p8 被放逐，狼 p12 获胜。该残局显示“谁更沉默”“谁重复前人观点”不足以替代对越权信息声明、历史投票和存活事实的结构化核查。
当前代码的 `_merge_public_notes` 和 `_snapshot_mapping` 使用宽泛关键词：只要存在 `target_id`、`target`、`text` 或 `reason`，就可能同时被判作 vote_like 或 claim_like；因此死亡、警徽转移、发言、行动记录和投票记录会相互污染。

当前代码存在重复定义的 `_collect_claim_block`、`_render_turn_summary`、`_render_vote_summary`、`_render_speak_summary`、`_rank_candidates`、`_least_suspicious_candidate`、`_score_candidate`、`_candidate_pool` 等方法。后定义覆盖前定义，实际行为与代码前半部分的意图不完全一致，增加了修改无效或只改到被覆盖版本的风险。
当前 `_score_candidate` 只是对包含玩家编号的字符串做关键词加减分：`狼`、`假`、`矛盾`等词会增加嫌疑，`金水`、`预言家`、`警徽`等词会降低嫌疑。它不区分谁说的、声明是否被公开事件支持、词语是否是否定语境，也不记录投票者与投票目标的关系，因此容易把“某人被别人称为狼”和“某人实际投了谁”视为同类证据。
当前投票摘要最多展示两个由启发式分数排序的候选，但候选池由 `known_player_ids`、当前状态和所有 action 的 target_ids 混合产生；这可能把已死、非当前合法目标或仅出现在历史文本中的玩家带入排序。代码虽然最后过滤部分 dead_ids，但没有以当前 day_vote 的合法 target_ids 作为投票目标的唯一硬边界。
task.md 要求维护清晰查验链、灰区名单、死亡和投票，但当前代码的台账实际只保留有限字符串并且缺少明确的“系统事实/玩家声明/推测”字段，任务要求和运行时提供给模型的结构不一致。
n00083 的未评估 patch 针对性修复了最严重的污染点：用事件类型驱动的结构化记录替代“有 target_id 就是 vote”，并把查验、角色声明、支持、对跳、死亡、投票分别存储。这是值得采用的方向，但因仍为 pending，不能把其效果视为已验证事实。
n00028/n00054 等分支尝试加入大量自动工作记忆和候选打分，n00056 因 fallback/错误失败，n00047 因 invalid decisions 超限被丢弃；这些失败经验表明不应继续大幅增加复杂解析器或改变行动契约，应保持 bounded、可测试、schema 无关的最小改动。

root_causes.impact: 发言中的 target、行动记录中的 target_id、警徽记录和投票记录可能被压成同一类“票型/声明”，模型无法知道证据来源和可靠等级。

root_causes.impact: 跨轮记忆没有真正实现 task.md 要求的公共账本；尤其无法稳定回溯“谁声明了什么、谁支持谁、谁在哪一轮投了谁、某信息是否为系统公开事实”。

root_causes.cause: 候选评分只按玩家编号是否出现在文本及关键词计分
root_causes.impact: 被指控者、指控者、投票者、投票目标和旁观者没有角色分离；否定句、转述、玩家声明与系统事件也没有分离，造成过度保护或过度怀疑。

root_causes.cause: 提示中的保护规则过强且缺少反证优先级
root_causes.impact: “持续报验”“警徽链”“金水”容易被模型当作接近系统确认，尽管 task.md 明确规定玩家声明不能升级为系统事实；在查验链断裂或有越权信息时仍可能延续旧站边。

root_causes.impact: 后续 patch 可能只修改到前面的同名方法，或者不同方法使用不同台账语义，导致行为与诊断预期不一致。

root_causes.cause: 当前轮对话读取和跨轮台账之间缺少明确的优先级与冲突处理
root_causes.impact: 模型容易被当前轮多数人的重复话术带偏，忽略早期硬事实、异常信息来源和历史票型；game14 第 5 轮四人残局的互投就是此类风险的具体表现。

modification_plan.change: 为台账增加明确的公开事实与玩家声明分层：系统公开事件包括 alive/dead、公开投票结果、公开死亡、公开当选/警徽变化；玩家声明包括发言、自称身份、查验、支持、对跳和遗言。生成 prompt 时分别输出 `verified_public_facts`、`player_claims`、`vote_records`、`death_records`、`badge_records`，不要再用一段混合的 `public_claims` 文本。
modification_plan.rationale: 使模型可以按 task.md 的证据优先级推理，并防止把“某人说昨晚谁吃刀”当成系统确认。

modification_plan.change: 重写候选池：在 day_vote 或 sheriff_election_vote 阶段，优先且仅使用对应 allowed action 的当前 `target_ids`；排除自身、明确死亡者和不合法目标。候选评分只对结构化记录计算，分别累计 `direct_public_fact`、`claim_conflict`、`vote_pattern`、`death_pattern`、`support/opposition`，不要对任意包含玩家编号的字符串做关键词加分。
modification_plan.rationale: 保证模型比较的是本轮真实可投的人，并使“票型异常”“事实矛盾”“声明来源不明”成为不同证据，而不是混成一个分数。

modification_plan.change: 调整投票摘要为固定的双候选比较框架：输出两个当前合法候选、各自 2 至 3 条可追溯证据、一个反证或不确定性说明，以及最终选择。若存在两个以上合法目标且至少一个有硬矛盾、越权信息声明或成组票型异常，明确提示模型不得 pass；只有候选近似等价或 pass 能避免明确误伤独立硬事实保护对象时才允许考虑 pass。
modification_plan.rationale: 将 task.md 中“至少比较两个候选”和“少弃票”从软提示变成稳定的输入结构，减少残局中的随意 pass 或跟随多数。

modification_plan.change: 修改保护链提示：将“金水、预言家、警徽链、强神”统一标为玩家声明或公开行为，不再使用容易被理解为系统确认的“默认提高保护权重”单句。加入反证优先级：明确公开死亡/投票事实和硬对跳、事实错误、来源不明的越权信息声明优先于持续重复的站边。
modification_plan.rationale: game14 中 p11 的“昨晚 p5 吃刀”就是来源不明声明；下一代应优先要求解释来源，而不是仅依据发言是否与多数一致。

modification_plan.change: 在 `_turn_instruction` 或生成的 turn summary 中加入残局协议：存活人数不超过 6 时，先列当前存活和已死，再列仍然有效的公开事实、已断裂的查验/警徽链、每个候选的最后两次投票与关键声明，最后才给出 Top2。已死玩家的遗言只能作为声明，不能直接升级为事实。
modification_plan.rationale: 针对 game14 后半段的主要失败模式，避免模型被“沉默”“重复”“谁先点名”这种低权重特征替代硬事实复盘。

modification_plan.change: 将任务说明改成与结构化运行时一致的短协议：明确要求模型读取 `verified_public_facts` 与 `player_claims` 两栏，任何没有对应公开事件的夜间信息都标为来源不明；投票必须引用两个合法候选；残局必须复盘票型和来源不明声明；保留禁止伪造系统事实和禁止越权访问的原规则。
modification_plan.rationale: 减少 task.md、checklist 和实际 prompt 字段之间的语义漂移，并让模型知道如何使用新增结构，而不是继续依赖混合自然语言台账。

modification_plan.change: 为新解析器增加纯函数级测试或 smoke checks，覆盖：包含 `target_id` 的非投票事件不进入 votes；公开 `VOTE_CAST` 正确记录 voter/target/weight；`PLAYER_SPOKE` 进入 claims；`PLAYER_DIED` 进入 deaths；当前 day_vote 的候选不包含已死或历史目标；生成摘要长度仍受现有 prompt 限制。
modification_plan.rationale: n00056 和 n00047 的失败说明复杂 patch 很容易引发 fallback 或 invalid decision。测试应集中在本地解析和输出，不触碰 Runtime 契约。

risks: 结构化解析器如果过于严格，可能漏掉引擎实际公开状态中的字段变体；应保留普通 event bucket，并对未知事件只保存短文本，不要凭猜测升级成 vote 或 verified fact。
如果把所有玩家声明都降为低权重，模型可能错过真实预言家查杀或有效警徽传递；应保留声明之间的一致性、对跳、票型支持和死亡结果作为可计算证据，而不是简单全部忽略。
残局强制 Top2 可能在合法候选只有一个或候选几乎等价时制造虚假区分；代码应在候选不足时明确输出“信息不足”，但仍不得加入非合法目标。
更丰富的台账字段会增加 prompt 长度和 token 消耗；必须继续使用有界记录、短文本和固定字段，避免复制完整历史，也不能扩大外部预算。
当前 n00083 的结构化 patch 尚无评测结果，不能直接假定它提高胜率；建议只吸收其事件分类思想，先做小 patch 和 smoke test，再让外部评测决定是否保留。
修改 task.md 和 checklist 可能改变模型风格，使其发言更谨慎但信息量变少；应保留“关注一人、暂不投一人、说明依据”的发言要求，并观察是否出现过度 pass。
清理重复方法可能改变当前偶然生效的行为；需要以当前 Python 方法解析结果为基准，确保行动规范化、重试、工具预算和公开信息边界不被改变。
diagnosis.code_agent_brief: 请在候选工作区中改进 villager-n00029 的 Task-Agent，只修改 task_agent.py 和 task.md，不修改 Game Engine、规则、信息可见性、工具实现、行动 schema、审计、模型客户端或任何预算。目标是修复公开证据污染并提升判断质量，而不是增加隐藏信息或完整历史注入。第一步清理 task_agent.py 中重复定义的方法，确认最终生效版本。第二步把当前基于关键词的 `_snapshot_mapping`/`_merge_public_notes` 改成 bounded、事件类型驱动的结构化公开台账：明确区分 vote、death、role_claim、inspection_claim、support、opposition、badge、event；只有明确投票事件才记录 vote，不能因存在 target_id 就认作投票。记录至少包含 round、event_type、speaker/voter、target、source_kind、短 text，并分别向模型提供系统公开事实、玩家声明、票型、死亡、警徽和遗言摘要。第三步让 day_vote 候选池只来自当前 allowed_actions 的合法 target_ids，排除自身和已死者；投票摘要固定比较两个合法候选，每个候选给出可追溯证据和反证，存在明确矛盾、来源不明的夜间信息或成组票型时提示不要 pass。第四步把残局摘要改为先复盘存活/死亡、有效公开事实、断裂查验链、历史票型和声明来源，再给 Top2，避免只按沉默或重复发言打分。第五步更新 task.md，使模型明确 verified public facts 与 player claims 的区别，并把无公开来源的夜间信息标为来源不明。保留现有 normalize_decision、decision_error、工具数量、重试逻辑和 prompt 长度约束。加入本地 smoke tests 或可调用的纯函数检查，至少验证非投票 target_id 不污染 votes、公开投票/死亡/发言分类正确、当前候选合法且输出仍能生成有效 JSON。不要复制 n00083 的全部大 patch；只采用其结构化事件分类方向，并优先保持改动最小、可审计、低风险。
